visual_concept: 一只手拿着两卷纸，左边密密麻麻写满2000字prompt，右边只有200字；桌面摊开日历被划掉两个月，一台电脑屏幕上显示CRM、评分系统流程图，暗示工程化才是护城河。
image_prompt:
A FLAT EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION in classic editorial magazine cover art style. Ink and watercolor on textured paper, designed-not-rendered, with visible hand-drawn linework and intentional limited color palette. This is NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic concept-art image. Think the look of a printed editorial illustration on paper.

SUBJECT:
A person (engineering worker in a blue-gray work shirt) holds two scrolls of paper in their hands. The left scroll is densely covered with tiny text "2000 words" and feels heavy; the right scroll is succinct with just "200 words". On the desk surface, a desk calendar has two months crossed out with red marker, indicating wasted time. In the background, a computer monitor partially visible shows a system architecture diagram with labeled blocks: CRM, Scoring System, Feedback Loop. Scattered around are small gears and code printouts, reinforcing the engineering context.

STYLE (critical — must enforce):
- FLAT ILLUSTRATION, ink and watercolor style
- visible brush strokes, paper texture, hand-drawn linework
- matte finish, designed-not-rendered
- limited color palette with intentional negative space
- NO photorealism, NO CGI, NO cinematic rendering
- NO glossy plastic, NO chrome, NO 3D realism
- NO photographic depth-of-field, NO bokeh

LIGHTING & MOOD:
- soft, even lighting suitable for flat illustration
- Not cinematic lighting, not realistic shadows

COMPOSITION (the one principle: CANVAS UNITY):
- 2.35:1 horizontal aspect ratio = 47:20 (1920×816)
- The whole canvas is one designed object: the person, scrolls, calendar, and monitor are visually connected by the desk surface and intentional negative space. The title text is integrated into the illustration – placed at the upper left corner, slightly overlapping the desk edge, linked by a thin line to the calendar. No floating elements. Every region has purpose: the lower right corner has a gear pattern as texture, not accidental emptiness. The left side (2000-word scroll) leads the eye to the right (200-word scroll) and then to the calendar and title. No islands, no dead zones.

COLOR PALETTE (strict, with area proportions):
- Dominant background: concrete light gray #E4E7EA (~50%) as the main reading surface
- Brand signature: steel blue #20384F (~20%) used for the main subject linework (person's shirt, scroll outlines, bold title edges)
- Secondary: slate gray #5A6672 (~15%) for shadows, calendar, secondary text on the screen
- Emphasis: cobalt blue #0F5C8C (~10%) for the "200 words" text on the right scroll and the calendar cross-out
- Ignition accent: industrial safety orange #E8703A (~5%) for the red marker cap and a single gear on the desk
- Color philosophy: cold gray base with precise steel blue signature and one warm point.
- NO pure black, NO pure white, NO rainbow gradients, NO neon.

TEXT IN IMAGE:
- main title: "2000字Prompt白写了" — Chinese large font (Source Han Sans Bold), steel blue, placed at upper left, occupying ~40% of visual weight
- corner small text: none (subtitle_text is empty, do not render any corner text)

NEGATIVE:
- NO abstract neural network diagrams
- NO glowing brain or digital head
- NO robot-human handshake
- NO circuit board background
- NO data stream / particle flows
- NO gradient geometric shapes
- NO VR goggles, NO AR headsets
- NO holographic UI floating in air
- NO futuristic city skyline
- NO chrome/metallic AI face
- NO binary code rain
- NO glossy plastic finish
- NO real-world brand logos or trademarks
- NO photographic realism, NO cinematic concept art
